_doc: Village layout in tiles (TILE = 64 px). Origin top-left. Buildings: rect in tiles, door = wall side + offset (tiles from left/top of that wall) + width. Interiors are drawn when the player is inside (roof fades). 'upstairs' areas live outside the village bounds and are reached by stairs.

interact.label: The Hall of Fame — the smithy's proudest work

units.name: Ironhand Smithy
units.desc: A modest shopfront, a smoky smithing hall and a narrow stock hall — and up the stair, a small room under the roof with a cot.

units.name: Hesketh's Cobblery
units.desc: Stone-walled and cool, behind your forge. Hesketh wants to retire to his daughter's farm.

units.name: Widow Marla's Laundry
units.desc: Steam, tubs and lye. Good ventilation — an alchemist's dream.

units.name: The Weaver's Room
units.desc: Bright, with long tables. Ilse is moving to the harbour lofts.

units.name: The Cellar Dig
units.occupant: solid earth under the stock hall
units.desc: Dig out a dry cellar under the smithy: a stair down from the stock hall and a store-room for ore, coal and hides.
units.becomes: a cellar store, reached by a stair from the stock hall

units.name: The Deep Vault
units.desc: Dig on under the cellar into the old dye-works' foundations: a long vault with thick stone walls, fit to hold arcane energies.

units.name: The Household Wing
units.occupant: the Ashby family's old rooms under the roof
units.desc: The rest of the roof space beside your quarters: a living room with a hearth, a bedroom, storage and a pantry with a bath.

units.name: Ilse's Loft
units.occupant: Ilse the weaver (her looms and bolts under the roof)
units.desc: The long loft under the roof above her room: dormer light, dry air and Ilse's old goods hoist. She lets it go with her room.
units.becomes: a weaving & tailoring loft, reached by a stair from the stock hall

units.name: The West Garret
units.occupant: the reeve's archive (old tithe rolls nobody reads)
units.desc: Two quiet rooms under the west roof: one warm over the forge, one cool over the stone rune room.
units.becomes: a drying loft for herbs and a rune scriptorium
